saw_lines: Home fitness buyers pick a machine for their living room, so they look for proof from other owners before they commit.
So the sale is won or lost in the ad, where a new buyer needs a reason to trust the machine.
Your site shows 182 reviews, yet 0 of your 8 ads carry that number. Put 182 on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
